lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee aau sakhee vas aau sakhee asee pir kaa ma(n)gal gaavah ||
lines.translation: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maan sakhee taj maan sakhee mat aapane preetam bhaavah ||
lines.translation: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters, so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar doojaa sev ek nira(n)jano ||
lines.translation: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the One Immaculate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: lag charan saran daiaal preetam sagal durat bikha(n)dano ||
lines.translation: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi daas daasee taj udaasee bahuR bidhee na dhaavaa ||
lines.translation: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with other devices.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai karahu kirapaa taam ma(n)gal gaavaa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs of bliss. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit pri kaa naam mai a(n)dhule tohanee ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh johai bahu parakaar su(n)dar mohanee ||
lines.translation: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohanee mahaa bachitr cha(n)chal anik bhaav dikhaavae ||
lines.translation: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi dheeth meethee manahi laagai naam lain na aavae ||
lines.translation: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he does not chant the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih banahi teerai barat poojaa baat ghaatai johanee ||
lines.translation: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on the roads and on the shore, she is spying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai daiaa dhaarahu mai naam a(n)dhule tohanee ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name is my cane. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi anaath pri naath jiu jaanahu tiu rakhahu ||
lines.translation: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As it pleases You, so do You protect me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaturaaee mohi naahi reejhaavau kahi mukhahu ||
lines.translation: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah chatur sughar sujaan betee mohi niragun gun nahee ||
lines.translation: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah roop dhoop na nain ba(n)ke jah bhaavai tah rakh tuhee ||
lines.translation: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai jaia(n)pahi sagal jaa kau karunaapat gat kin lakhahu ||
lines.translation: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sev sevak jiu jaanahu tiu mohi rakhahu ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserve me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi machhulee tum neer tujh bin kiu sarai ||
lines.translation: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi chaatrik tumh boo(n)d tripatau mukh parai ||
lines.translation: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I am satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh parai harai piaas meree jee heeaa praanapate ||
lines.translation: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, my heart, my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laadile laad ladaai sabh mahi mil hamaaree hoi gate ||
lines.translation: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may be emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheet chitavau mit a(n)dhaare jiu aas chakavee din charai ||
lines.translation: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakvi duck, which longs to see the dawn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai pri sa(n)g melee machhulee neer na veesarai ||4||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n hamaare bhaag ghar aaiaa pir meraa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohe ba(n)k duaar sagalaa ban haraa ||
lines.translation: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har haraa suaamee sukhah gaamee anad ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
lines.translation: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy, bliss and love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naval navatan naahu baalaa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
lines.translation: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; what tongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree sej sohee dekh mohee sagal sahasaa dukh haraa ||
lines.translation: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and pains are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai meree aas pooree mile suaamee apara(n)paraa ||5||1||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ma(n)gal ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar saa(n)t daiaal prabh sarab sukhaa nidh peeu ||
lines.translation: God is beautiful, tranquil and merciful; He is the treasure of absolute peace, my Husband Lord.
